g.text: M3 AND LATER (DYNAMIC CACHING): REGISTERS, THREADGROUP, TILE AND STACK ARE ALLOCATED ON DEMAND FROM ONE ON-CORE CACHE POOL
GPU LAST-LEVEL CACHE (L2, SHARED BY ALL CORES)
SYSTEM LEVEL CACHE (SLC, TENS OF MB - SHARED WITH CPU + ANE)
UNIFIED MEMORY (LPDDR DRAM - ONE POOL FOR CPU AND GPU. M5: ~153 GB/S, M5 MAX: ~614 GB/S)
